reason: No auto-charge on the trial means I'd actually start it, which is rare for me. But when day 14 comes I'd probably just drop to the free version with a 60-minute timer and YouTube rain sounds, like I do with every app.
objection: I already get sleep sounds for free. And would a phone lying on the mattress really know when I fell asleep or woke up at 4am, or would it just give me a nice-looking report to sell me the upgrade?
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 comparison showed I got back to sleep clearly faster after waking up at night, like 10+ minutes faster, I'd pay the 4,900 for one month to see if it holds up.
